description: Zero-argument diagnostic call: returns exactly what build is live right now (build_sha, schema_version, schema_hash, archive_revision, tool_count, generated_at, server_environment). The schema_hash identifies the deployed tool list, so two connections can be compared: a mismatch usually means one connection holds a stale cached manifest, not a real deployment gap.
name: system_status

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Colour Memory Diagnostic / Version Status
